description: On the blue-covered bed in front of a pink pillow, there’s a small stack of light-blue bowls near the center. The left hand stays resting on the fabric while the right hand reaches in, grips the top bowl of the stack, lifts it upward, moves it to the right, and sets it down to separate it; then the right hand lifts another bowl from the right side and places it down nearer the front so the bowls end up unstacked and spread out.
